children: Planet Labs reported record revenue of $116.1 million for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, up 58% year‑over‑year, and delivered adjusted EBITDA of $13.9 million. GAAP net loss narrowed to $9.4 million for the quarter, while non‑GAAP diluted EPS was $0.02. The company ended the quarter with $865.4 million in cash, cash equivalents and short‑term investments and announced operational progress across satellite launches, manufacturing and international partnerships.
Revenue: $116.1 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (up 58% YoY).
Gross profit: $65.6 million; GAAP gross margin 57% and non‑GAAP gross margin 59% for the quarter.
Loss from operations (GAAP): $(13.5) million for the quarter.
Net loss (GAAP): $(9.4) million for the quarter; GAAP net loss per share: $(0.03).
Adjusted EBITDA: $13.9 million for the quarter; non‑GAAP net income per diluted share: $0.02.

Customer wins and contracts: Awarded an $8 million OTA from the U.S. National Geospatial‑Intelligence Agency and a tender award from the German government for dedicated satellite services (up to €25 million over 5 years); additional European government and Rwanda Space Agency contracts signed.
Product and service momentum: Recurring ACV represented 98% of the book at quarter end, with backlog and remaining performance obligations supporting multi‑year revenue visibility.

Satellite and launch activity: Successfully launched the Pelican‑11 tech demo; shipped Tanager‑2 and 18 SuperDove satellites to Vandenberg for an upcoming Transporter‑18 mission; strategic launch agreement with Isar Aerospace announced.

Manufacturing and geographic expansion: Began initial setup for an expanded Berlin manufacturing facility and opened a new London office focused on AI and analytics partnerships to deepen engagement with UK and NATO stakeholders.

Technology and AI: Progressed Planet AI application to open beta to enable natural‑language queries of Planet’s global imagery archive; launched Pelican high‑resolution data use cases with hyperscaler customers for data center and semiconductor facility monitoring.

title: Planet Labs Reports Q2 FY2027: Record $116.1M Revenue, Adjusted EBITDA $13.9M
